display_name: Phase1 旧恢复锚定与梯度平衡生成轨迹
description: 冻结原 Phase1 DURA 和 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL，使用 DURA 输出为生成轨迹起点，源训练时对波形与语义梯度进行冲突投影和幅度限制。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发不同于另一个对话的星地恢复网络；只看 Phase1 地面训练测试集；地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；每个星地视图相对同一冻结基座 clean 损失不超过 3 个百分点。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch, FP32, TF32 off; original Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME immutable release

data.representation: Phase1 R07 source paired received/clean IQ; frozen DURA anchor computed from received, no inference-time channel metadata
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels, V or test IQ during source training
data.augmentation: Source 20 views then repeat first10; fixed randomized source order with 25% clean identity

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s/U_s source IQ with frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no TX/V/test during training
permissions.query_use: Frozen per-record prediction with no adaptation
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed Phase1 development test already observed; not a blind confirmation

checkpoint.initialization: Original Phase1 DURA E20/4940 frozen + Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50/11100 frozen + new zero-output field
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA original 7/63/30 source-only metadata and pinned release; F exact original checkpoint ancestry and matching L_s/U_s IDs; DURA SHA bound into field checkpoint
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both inherited Phase1 models are source-only and frozen; generation field from scratch
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E30, two fixed antithetic four-step paths; no test-dependent parameter selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU true F/G source smoke; shared lock; count same-user restoration GPU workers <2, per-card existing compute PIDs <2 and same UID, >=12000 MB; explicit legacy capacity-accounting marker; persistent GPU worker B128 smoke then fresh training and prediction
execution.stop_rule: Wrong F/G/source roles, nonfinite gradient, source smoke failure, GPU capacity ambiguity, collision, changed frozen weights, incomplete prediction or score failure: preserve evidence; no automatic rerun or performance-based stop

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: r01 CPU smoke 参考 train 与重载 eval 模式逐位比较失败；真实权重参数一致，统一 eval 模式逐位一致。r02 只修复 smoke 参考模式，正式科学配方不变。
冻结 DURA 输出作为两条反向噪声四步轨迹的起点，速度场每步同时以原 received IQ 为条件；零输出初始化时轨迹均值严格保持 DURA。
source-wave = IQ NMSE + 0.05 相对 anchor 偏移；source-semantic = F 特征误差 + 0.25 双路径特征差 + 0.01 clean 到两路径的分类分布 KL。
对生成场所有参数计算两组梯度：语义与波形梯度点积为负时去掉相反方向，再将语义梯度范数限制到不超过波形梯度范数；合并、全局裁剪后 AdamW。该性质仅为预优化器梯度约束，不保证 AdamW 实际下降或识别性能。
0.01 来自事先登记的 LOS／BLOCKED 源梯度尺度规则；固定源数据，不读 TX 标签或测试数据进行更新。输入和 clean 目标仅 Phase1 原 L_s/U_s 源集；DURA、F 参数和状态保持冻结。
真实 F/G 两条 L_s CPU 检查后，GPU 上使用 128 条 L_s 受扰源样本对临时 field 做一次完整 smoke；临时权重随后丢弃，正式训练从固定种子、warmup 第 1 步重新初始化。
先前 Phase1 开发测试已被研究过程观察，本候选方案构思发生在观察之后，故后续同集仅属开发评估，不可作为独立盲测或未接触测试的证明。
固定 E30/14790；全部七视图 raw/restored 分类决策固定后独立 CPU truth-last 评分；不以其他候选测试结果调整本 run 的配方或中途停止。

rows.method: Frozen Phase1 DURA anchor + conditional two-path Transformer flow, projected source semantic gradients
rows.purpose: Train a trajectory correction anchored on a strong fixed source restoration while managing source gradient conflict
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026092701, order 2026110104, training noise 2026110105, fixed inference noise template 2026110103; existing Phase1 split and views
rows.scenario: Phase1 R07 L_s/U_s training; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
rows.optimizer: AdamW, gradient projection and norm cap
rows.budget_ref: E30 x63000, batch128, 14790 updates; per source batch frozen DURA + two 4-step paths and frozen Tri-SIG F; two generator gradient passes; clean quarter; F/G updates 0
